summary_en: The bishop asked what he was doing and, seeing the mouse, said a man of his kind should not touch such a creature: let it go for seven pounds.
summary_zh: 主教问他在做什么，马纳维丹说：我在绞死一个小偷。

summary_en: Manawydan demanded one more thing: Llwyd's oath never again to enchant Dyfed nor take vengeance on Pryderi, Rhiannon or himself.
summary_zh: 马纳维丹说：我还要你发誓，以后永远不再对达费德施魔法，不再向普雷德里、里安农或我自己报复，为这件事报仇。

summary_en: One day after a feast at Arberth the four went up Gorsedd Arberth with their company — the mound where Pwyll had first seen Rhiannon.
summary_zh: 一天，他们四人在阿伯斯的宫殿里宴饮，饭后，带着随从们走上了阿伯斯的土丘——就是当年皮威尔第一次看见里安农的地方。

summary_en: 'We cannot go on like this,' said Manawydan; 'let us go to England and take up a craft to earn our living.' At Hereford they made saddles; Manawydan shaped them well and coloured them with blue enamel, as he had seen it done by Llasar Llaes Gyfnewid, and the townspeople bought no saddles but theirs.
summary_zh: 马纳维丹说：我们不能再这样过下去了，我们到英格兰去，学一门手艺来谋生吧。

summary_en: In a third town Pryderi asked what craft they would take up now.
summary_zh: 他们来到第三个城市，普雷德里问：我们这次做什么手艺？

summary_en: One morning Manawydan and Pryderi went hunting, and their hounds ran into a thicket and came back bristling in terror.
summary_zh: 一天早晨，马纳维丹和普雷德里带着猎犬去打猎，猎犬们冲进一片灌木丛，又惊恐地退了回来，毛都竖了起来。
title_en: The white boar and the strange fortress

summary_en: Inside the fortress there was no man, no house, no hounds or boar — only a fountain in the middle with a marble slab beside it, and on the slab a golden bowl hung by four chains that went up into the sky out of sight.
summary_zh: 普雷德里走进城堡，里面没有人，没有房屋，也没有他的猎犬和野猪，只在城堡中央有一口泉水，泉水边有一块大理石板，石板上放着一只金碗，金碗用四根链子吊着，链子一直延伸到天上，看不见尽头。
title_en: The golden bowl and the vanished fortress

summary_en: Only Manawydan and Pryderi's wife Cigfa were left at Arberth.
summary_zh: 阿伯斯的宫殿里，只剩下马纳维丹和普雷德里的妻子基格瓦两个人了。

summary_en: When the wheat was ripe Manawydan said he would reap the first croft next day; at dawn he found only bare straw, every ear cut off and carried away.
summary_zh: 麦子成熟了，马纳维丹去看第一块麦田，说：明天我就来收割。

summary_en: Of all the mice only one lagged behind, heavy and slow, and Manawydan caught it, put it in his glove, tied the mouth with a string, carried it home and hung the glove on a peg.
summary_zh: 那么多老鼠一下子都逃走了，只有一只老鼠跑得慢，因为它的身体又重又胖，落在了后面。

summary_en: Math son of Mathonwy was king of Gwynedd, and he could not live unless his feet were in the lap of a maiden, except when war prevented it.
summary_zh: 马索努伊的儿子马斯是格温内斯的国王。
title_zh: 持足少女与普雷德里的猪

summary_en: Gronw took Lleu's court and lands.
summary_zh: 格罗努占据了勒伊的宫殿和土地。

summary_en: Lleu was brought to Caer Dathyl, and all the best physicians of Gwynedd tended him until by the year's end he was whole again.
summary_zh: 勒伊被带到卡耳·达瑟尔，格温内斯所有最好的医生都来为他治疗，到了年底，他终于恢复了健康。

summary_en: Gronw Pebr fled to Penllyn and sent to ask whether Lleu would take land or gold and silver in compensation.
summary_zh: 格罗努·佩布尔逃回了他的领地彭林，派使者去问勒伊，愿不愿意接受土地、金银作为赔偿。

summary_en: Discovering the deceit, Pryderi marched north with the men of the south, and war broke out; Math mustered Gwynedd against him.
summary_zh: 普雷德里发现自己被骗了，带着南方的大军向北追来，战争爆发了。

summary_en: When Math returned and would put his feet in Goewin's lap, she told him to seek another maiden, for she was one no longer, and told him what had been done.
summary_zh: 马斯回到宫中，要把双脚放在戈尔文的膝上。

summary_en: Math needed a new footholder, and Gwydion proposed his sister Arianrhod daughter of Dôn.
summary_zh: 马斯需要一位新的持足少女，格威迪恩推荐了他的妹妹、多恩的女儿阿丽安萝德。

summary_en: One morning Gwydion heard a cry from the chest, opened it and found a little boy stretching out his arms.
summary_zh: 有一天早晨，格威迪恩在床上听见箱子里传出哭声，他打开箱子，看见一个小男孩伸出双臂。
title_en: The fair one with the skilful hand

summary_en: Arianrhod, tricked, laid a second destiny: he should never bear arms until she armed him herself.
summary_zh: 阿丽安萝德知道自己上当了，又下了第二个命运：除非我亲手给他武器，否则他永远不能拥有武器。

summary_en: Furious, Arianrhod laid a third destiny: he should never have a wife of the race that was now on the earth.
summary_zh: 阿丽安萝德愤怒至极，下了第三个命运：他永远不能娶这世上任何一个种族的女子为妻。

summary_en: One day while Lleu was visiting Math, Blodeuedd, walking in the court at Mur Castell, heard a horn and saw a weary stag pass with hounds and huntsmen after it: Gronw Pebr, lord of Penllyn, was hunting.
summary_zh: 一天，勒伊去拜访马斯，布罗黛维德独自留在穆尔·卡斯泰尔。

summary_en: That night Blodeuedd was silent, and when Lleu asked why, she said she feared he would die before her.
summary_zh: 那天晚上，布罗黛维德一言不发，勒伊问她为什么不高兴。
title_en: Neither in a house nor out of doors

summary_zh: KTU 1.2 IV把巴力与雅姆置于同一战斗事件中；库存记录确保故事锚定到具体泥板。

summary_zh: 已登记的学术资料把Yagrush与Ayyamur列为巴力依次使用的有名武器。
